purpose: Use real running-script and running-cursive works as the stylistic and compositional core for character collection and missing-character completion.
hardRules: A glyph candidate is not ranked by visual similarity alone.
Neighbour compatibility and line rhythm are first-class evidence.
Do not normalize every glyph to the same box, baseline, scale, or spacing.
Original pair/triplet/line relationships must be retained as training evidence before character cropping.
Cross-calligrapher material may inform general running-script grammar but must not silently impersonate another calligrapher.
Generated or reconstructed missing glyphs must be labelled as reconstructed and remain distinct from source glyphs.
